newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian gov't fiscal deficit at 4.0 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Colombian gov't fiscal deficit at 4.0 pct of GDP.

text.p: The Colombian government's fiscal deficit widened to 4.0 percent of gross domestic product in the first half of 1996, the Comptroller General's office said.
It gave no comparative figure for the first half of 1995 but said central government spending had increased 41 percent during the first six months of 1996 over the same period in 1995.
The biggest increase came in the form of a whopping 158 percent increase in domestic interest rate payments, the Comptroller General's office said in a statement.
